description: Bello! Gru said: "We are going to steal THE MOON!" We just want to land on it, which might be harder. At the lunar south pole the Sun barely clears the horizon and Earth vanishes for two weeks a month. Our web app uses real NASA data to show when the Sun sets and Earth disappears at any landing site, and what happens if a launch slips. Four Minions from Port Louis, crew complete. We steal the Moon. Well, we plan the landing. BANANA! Poopaye!
